kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنصبن (form VII)
# أَنْصَبِنُ (ʔanṣabinu) /ʔan.sˤa.bi.nu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْصَبَنَ (inṣabana)
# أَنْصَبِنَ (ʔanṣabina) /ʔan.sˤa.bi.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْصَبَنَ (inṣabana)
# أَنْصَبِنْ (ʔanṣabin) /ʔan.sˤa.bin/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْصَبَنَ (inṣabana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
